limitations: Administrative inspect is an installed primitive, not a user-serving authorization or canonical save receipt. Reachability positive is independent fixture control enrollment.

Clearing the exact held byte buffers does not promise complete process-memory zeroization, erasure of descriptive JS strings or recall of already delivered data.
Authenticated canonical publication/settled original content command, whole-service/witness-append crash, backup/content-loss restore and E01-E04 remain pending.

Surviving current PG/witness/material authority, independently held ephemeral fixture keys and trusted single-host directory custody remain required. All X01-X09, KMS/rotation, hardware/multi-host/remote and enterprise hold qualification remain pending.
